description: One external verification case (G-164): its newest attempt number and the decision of that attempt. Attempts are numbered 1, 2, 3 without gaps. The server writes these records; no role writes them by hand.

fields.description: The case id that the provider's notices refer to. It is unique, so each case has one record.
fields.label: Case ID

fields.description: The newest attempt. Only this attempt can decide.
fields.label: Latest Attempt

fields.description: The attempt that gave the stored outcome. 0 means no outcome yet.
fields.label: Decided Attempt

fields.description: Outcome of the decided attempt. The case is pending when the decided attempt is not the latest one.
fields.label: Outcome

name: PLT Verification Case
